decision_evidence.text: Juiced remains a model appliance for external clients. Keep artifact identity, execution profiles, Disabled / On demand / Hot policies, observed worker state, temporary service tests and bounded diagnostics. Retain the eight console destinations in the eventual migration. Do not introduce saved conversations, a general agent framework or model-weight conversion. Barista is the sole optional operator-assistant feature. Its required B0-B4 work follows the upstream P0-P6 sequence below. It is not deferred to the optional scale phase.

**J006, published variants.** Local model conversion, quantization, calibration, repacking and export remain excluded in every phase. Preserve retained derivatives as ordinary existing weights and keep unresolved writer charges/references until confirmed terminal cleanup. F028 means existing Q4NX acquisition only; F031/F032/F034 mean safe retirement and retained references, not a producer revival. F194 means only the bounded Barista exception, not general agents.
